_help: Product demonstration videos from the official channel https://www.youtube.com/@KotibhaskarIndustries
To add a video: copy one entry, set 'id' to the 11-character code after 'youtu.be/' or 'watch?v=',
a short 'title', the 'duration' shown on YouTube, and the product page URL(s) in 'pages'. Then run
python tools/build_site.py. The first video listed for a page is its main video; others appear under 'More videos'.
The build stops with an error if a page URL does not exist.
